claim: POST /procurement/documents/:id/lines/:lineId/link (DocumentsController.linkLine -> DocumentIntakeService.confirmLineMatch) pairs a document line only with an order line of the caller's own house. Before the pairing write, confirmLineMatch reads procurement_order_items by the body's orderLineId through procurement_orders!inner, filtered to procurement_orders.restaurant_id = the caller's house, and also requires the embedded order's restaurant_id to equal it; another house's order line and an id that does not exist both throw ORDER_LINE_NOT_FOUND, which the route answers 404 'This restaurant has no order line with that id, so the line was not paired.' with nothing written. orderLineId null (unpair) reads no order line and is unchanged. At a323cc80b confirmLineMatch checked only that the DOCUMENT line was the house's and wrote any order line id it was given. Pinned by proposal-preservation.spec.ts (describe 'confirmLineMatch — a line pairs only with its own house's order line', 6 cases, 4 red on a323cc80b's service and controller). NOT covered: pairings stored before the fix (production not queried), and readers that join through order_line_id without a house filter (canonical-document.service.ts resolveLines reads procurement_order_items by id only), both filed in tech-debt.d/2026-10-07-fix-a-line-pairs-only-with-its-own-house.md.
